data.name: Aabroo
data.gender_notes: Aabroo is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Persian ābrū (آبرو) 'honour, dignity, reputation', literally 'water of the face', from āb (آب) 'water' and rū (رو) 'face'. The image is of the face that must not be shamed. Borrowed into Urdu with the same sense. Aabroo therefore means “Honour; dignity; reputation; good name”. Persian noun ābrū 'honour, dignity, reputation'; used as a female given name in Persian and Urdu.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabroo expresses “Delight, Pleasure”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabroo total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

faq.q: What does Aabroo literally mean in Persian?
faq.a: Aabroo is the Persian word ābrū (آبرو), literally 'water of the face' - from āb 'water' and rū 'face'. It means 'honour, dignity, reputation', the idea being the face one must not allow to be shamed.

faq.q: What does the name Aabroo mean?
faq.a: Aabroo means “Honour; dignity; reputation; good name”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aabroo come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabroo?
faq.a: The root of Aabroo is Persian ābrū (آبرو), from āb (آب) 'water' + rū (رو) 'face'.

faq.q: How is Aabroo written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabroo is written آبرو in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabroo a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabroo is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aabroo appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabroo is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabroo verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Honour; dignity; reputation; good name” is established by Persian noun ābrū 'honour, dignity, reputation'; used as a female given name in Persian and Urdu..
